title: The Word Legacy
short_teaser: Legacy once referred strongly to something handed down, especially through a will.
story: Legacy once referred strongly to something handed down, especially through a will. Today it includes influence, stories, values, systems, and consequences passed forward. What we leave behind is often larger than what can be listed as property. Words shape what we notice and remember. Naming an experience can make it easier to understand, share, and use. The lasting value is not merely knowing the fact. It is seeing the pattern beneath it and considering where that same pattern may already be present in ordinary life, creative work, or business.
